name: clanker
description: Codex dispatcher adapter for external Opencode and Grok Clankers over ACP.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch external coding agents without self-dispatch
interface.longDescription: Dispatch bounded read-only or isolated write tasks from Codex to external Opencode and Grok workers through the host-aware Clanker ACP runtime.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch an external read-only review through Clanker.
